title: arabis soyeri subsp. jacquinii
intro: Arabis soyeri subsp. jacquinii, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health, thanks to its health benefits such as antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rock Cress include its ability to stimulate the digestive system, relieve congestion, and soothe sore throats. The bioactive constituents of Arabis soyeri subsp. jacquinii include glucosinolates, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
